exposure: Pinggan Yiqi Yangshen recipe combined with labetalol hydrochloride and magnesium sulfate
finding: Pinggan Yiqi Yangshen recipe combined with labetalol hydrochloride and magnesium sulfate effectively reduced blood pressure, improved biochemical and renal function, and lowered the incidence of cesarean section, preterm birth, and abnormal fetal heart rate in patients with pregnancy-induced hypertension.
mod_finding: The incidence of cesarean section, preterm birth, and abnormal fetal heart rate was significantly lower in the experimental group (Pinggan Yiqi Yangshen recipe combined with labetalol hydrochloride and magnesium sulfate).
